_readme: Ve's file: the model, turn cap, time limit, USD cap and daily cap of each kind of claude session (run-loop.ps1 starts one session per job). Edit by hand; the loop only reads it. Missing or empty values fall back to the defaults in gate-rules.ps1 ($SessionDefaults, $LoopOptionDefaults). A build uses build.smallModel when its issue carries one of build.smallLabels, else build.model. maxBudgetUsd is passed to claude as --max-budget-usd (0 = no cap); a build on a model that is not Opus uses build.smallMaxBudgetUsd. A session stopped by its USD cap mid-build is failure class max-budget (retried once, like max-turns). maxPerDay: at most this many sessions of the kind start per local day across all runs (0 = no cap; counts in <LOOP_HOME>\state\daily-sessions.json). options: proposeIssueDigest (the runner lists the issues once into the proposal header), compactPrompts (build-only LOOP.md blocks left out of proposal/review prompts), logKeepDays (prune old logs at run start; rundata.json and run-<id>.log kept; 0 = never), digestMaxIssues, digestDeployedDays. intake: the session that plans one of your loop:request issues (your requests' sessions are not counted against the build/propose daily caps; intake has its own maxPerDay). memory: the tool-less Haiku memory agent (its JSON is validated by the runner). options.productStore (decision collector, D:\hub\state\product\cardlens), options.memoryAgent (preferences; needs productStore) and options.requestIntake (your loop:request issues) switch Phase 1 on; productCollectMinutes, memoryMinDecisions, memoryEveryDays tune them. options.designSkills lets build, proposal and review sessions use the pinned design aids under D:\loop-tools (impeccable engine: context / shot / detect; ui-ux-pro-max search.py) and adds LOOP.md section 9; the runner re-hashes the engine every run and turns the feature off on a mismatch (the taste skill is never available to the loop). run-loop.ps1 -Model / -MaxTurns override every session for one run (-Model never applies to memory).
